title: SGIC: A Self-Guided Iterative Calibration Framework for RAG
authors: Guanhua Chen; Yutong Yao; Lidia S. Chao; Xuebo Liu; Derek F. Wong
why_relevant: Proposes a self-guided iterative calibration framework using uncertainty scores over documents and answers to refine RAG outputs, directly addressing calibration/control and uncertainty estimation under retrieval noise.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on multi-hop QA accuracy rather than adversarial or conflict scenarios.
